purpose: Test whether the threshold credit-fragmentation phase law extends from balanced exact refinements to arbitrary weak compositions of fixed semantic evidence across exact identities.

frozen_parameters.partition_family: all weak integer compositions of N into k identity-local evidence counts

frozen_predictions.guaranteed_fragmentation_region: M <= N < kM implies fragmentation for every partition
frozen_predictions.partition_dependent_tail: N >= kM permits both invariant and fragmented partitions
frozen_predictions.balanced_partition_role: balanced allocation achieves the earliest possible native full retirement at N=kM and is therefore the best-case, not the only, partition

stop_if: Any exhaustive weak-composition count disagrees with the frozen closed-form formula or any partition in M<=N<kM is invariant.
